conflict: none — did not build, stage, or assemble
choice_reason: A demonstrates all three required states (copy confirmation, search no-results, 390px) working correctly, keeps the breaking-change note pinned during search, and ships noticeably more accessibility scaffolding (per-section aria-labelledby, two aria-live status regions vs B's one). B's content and visual design are competitive, but at the scenario's specified canonical route (/changelog/3.4.0) its relative asset paths (styles.css, app.js) resolve incorrectly, and I reproduced B's own static-file-server logic locally to confirm the CSS and JS both fail to load at that route — which matches B's own evidence screenshots showing no styling and a 'Copy key' button that never changes to 'Copied' despite the click being executed.

findings.label: B
findings.description: At the scenario's canonical route (/changelog/3.4.0), relative-path stylesheet and module-script requests resolve to the wrong URL and the static server's fallback silently serves index.html for them, so CSS and JS both fail to load; the required 'copy confirmation' and 'in-page search no-results' states never occur.
findings.evidence: B/evidence/state-01-copy-confirmation.png (button still reads 'Copy key' after the click), B/evidence/state-02-search-no-results.png (typed query 'zzz-no-match-zzz' but all sections remain visible, no no-results message); reproduced by re-implementing B/evidence/capture-plan.mjs's static-file-server routing logic and confirming GET /changelog/styles.css returns content-type text/html instead of CSS.

findings.label: B
findings.description: In-page navigation only jumps to the breaking-change section; there is no quick link to the Changed, Added, Fixed, or Deprecated sections, forcing a manual scroll to check those notes.
findings.evidence: B/desktop.png toolbar shows only a single 'Jump to breaking changes' control next to the search field.

findings.label: B
findings.description: Minimal ARIA structure: only one aria-live/role=status pair (the copy confirmation) is present in the markup, with no landmark or section labeling.
findings.evidence: grep of B/source/index.html for aria-*/role attributes returns a single match at line 51; A/source/index.html has 15 matches including per-section aria-labelledby.

findings.label: A
findings.description: A's own evidence capture never navigates to the scenario's specified canonical route (/changelog/3.4.0); it captures against /index.html instead, so route-level behavior at the assigned path is unverified by the provided evidence (though no client-side path-rewrite logic exists that would introduce B's failure mode).

findings.label: A
findings.description: The top search input's placeholder text is truncated mid-word in the desktop layout, a minor craft nit.
findings.evidence: A/desktop.png search field reads 'Search notes, e.g. "deploy" or "e' — cut off.
